summary.text: Gretchen Dobervich is a Democratic member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 11 (home city listed as Fargo), serving since 2016 per the legislature's member page; the page lists the role of Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Dobervich lists an occupation of Public Health Policy Program Director.
It lists education as MPH, NDSU; LBSW, MSU.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Dobervich's standing committee assignments as Agriculture and Human Services.
